# littlefoot.js

Website: https://littlefoot.js.org/
GitHub: https://github.com/goblindegook/littlefoot

To download latest versions, open a terminal in this directory and run the following commands:
```
curl -L -O https://unpkg.com/littlefoot/dist/littlefoot.js
curl -L -O https://unpkg.com/littlefoot/dist/littlefoot.css
```

_Last version downloaded: 4.1.3 (as of March 23, 2026)._
